mapper.select: select lr.dates, lr.pkg, dui.version, lr.register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lr.register_dates, lr.dates) register_day, count(DISTINCT lr.user_id) retention_user_num from dwd_user_login_record lr left join dim_user_info dui on dui.user_id = lr.user_id where lr.dates = #{dates} group by lr.dates, lr.pkg, dui.version, lr.register_dates
